title: Weak and standard BPP coincide
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model whose efficient verifiers remain efficient when amplified by majority repetition, and let $c$ be a natural number. For every language $L$ of bit strings, $L$ has a polynomial-time verifier with inverse-polynomial advantage over random guessing, with the advantage specified by $c$, if and only if $L$ has a polynomial-time verifier with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members and rejection probability at least $2/3$ on nonmembers.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings
